Route a software engineering task to the best AI agent and model by analyzing risk patterns, repository context, and task boundaries.

Prioritize reliability over cost for tasks involving: database schema changes, external API integrations, test infrastructure modifications, security-critical code, self-referential tooling improvements, or financial data handling. These risk patterns warrant high-capability models (Claude) regardless of perceived simplicity.

Consider task characteristics: Does it modify existing runtime code or create new isolated features? Does it cross integration boundaries or touch shared infrastructure? What is the blast radius if the implementation contains bugs?

Examine repository context and historical patterns. For repositories like 'wavemill' (meta-tooling), prefer Claude due to self-referential complexity. For well-scoped, isolated features with clear interfaces, cheaper models may suffice.

When confidence is uncertain, default to Claude—failed tasks cost more in debugging time than model costs. Only route to cheaper models when the task is genuinely low-risk: pure documentation, simple UI components, or well-defined adapters with comprehensive tests.

Always identify specific risk flags in your reasoning. Be conservative: routing 90% of tasks to Claude is acceptable if those tasks involve integration points, schema changes, or production runtime modifications.

# HOK-719: Add Balance to User Profile — Task Packet

## 1\. Objective

### What

Add a dollar-denominated balance field to the user profile that tracks funds available for paying API fees, and provide a UI for users to view their current balance.

### Why

Users need a prepaid balance mechanism to pay for API usage fees. This is a foundational requirement for the billing/usage system — without a visible balance, users can't understand their spending capacity or know when to add funds.

### Scope In

* Add a `balance` field to the user database schema (Prisma)
* Expose balance via the user profile API
* Display balance in the user dashboard/profile UI
* Display balance in the navigation (e.g., header user menu) for quick visibility

### Scope Out

* Adding funds / top-up flow (separate task)
* Deducting balance on API usage (separate task — usage fee router)
* Stripe or payment gateway integration
* Balance history / transaction ledger
* Low-balance notifications or alerts
* Admin tools for adjusting balances

---

## 2\. Technical Context

### Repository

`hokusai-site` (this repo)

### Key Files

*Files that will be created or modified:*

* `packages/web/prisma/schema.prisma` — Add balance field to User model
* `packages/web/prisma/migrations/*/migration.sql` — Generated migration
* `packages/web/src/app/api/user/profile/route.ts` (or equivalent profile endpoint) — Include balance in response
* `packages/web/src/app/(protected)/dashboard/page.tsx` (or equivalent) — Display balance
* `packages/web/src/components/` — Balance display component(s)
* `packages/web/src/components/ui/` — Any shared UI elements for currency formatting

### Dependencies

* PostgreSQL database (via Prisma)
* Existing auth/session system for identifying current user
* Existing user profile API endpoint
* Existing dashboard/profile page layout
